body:
## Summary
- require clipboard E2E retained artifacts to declare byte length and SHA-256, then verify both against the stored evidence files
- harden clipboard gate prerequisites for structured Host readiness, cross-source P0110/pacific device identity, Android origin device IDs, and non-boolean synthetic/offline-only flags
- make the Phase 0 aggregate require a passing formal clipboard E2E gate JSON with pass sub-checks before accepting a clipboard product E2E pass
- update README/aggregate clipboard gate language to describe the new artifact metadata requirement without claiming product E2E closure

## Verification
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_clipboard_e2e_gate tools.tests.test_phase0_stable_release -v
  - Ran 140 tests in 16.935s: OK
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -v
  - Ran 1477 tests in 37.150s: OK
- make clipboard-e2e-gate CLIPBOARD_E2E_GATE_JSON=.build/evidence/clipboard-e2e-hardening/clipboard-e2e-gate.json
  - verdict=blocked, result=blocked, gate_closed=false, can_close_android_macos_clipboard_e2e_gate=false, blockers=7
- make phase0-stable-release-gate PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_SUMMARY=.build/evidence/phase0-stable-release-hardening/phase0-stable-release-summary.json
  - aggregate_verdict=blocked, can_mark_phase0_stable_release=false, required_gate_count=13, closed_required_gate_count=6
- cd baseline/AndroidClient && ./gradlew --no-daemon testDebugUnitTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.protocol.ProtocolV1ClipboardTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.ClipboardApprovalStateTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.MainActivityClipboardSystemBoundaryContractTest
  - BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 6s
- git diff --check

## Boundaries
- Did not start Vibe Screen, MacHost, Telemachus, or any GUI Host process.
- Did not run swift run.
- Did not read, modify, or request TCC permissions.
- Did not run adb or create adb reverse mappings.
- Real Android ClipboardManager <-> macOS NSPasteboard USB/LAN product E2E remains open until retained Host-backed bidirectional evidence exists.
title: test(evidence): harden clipboard product e2e gate
